# Egret on draft 1b: generated tables

Cycles of each program's run: its run less the empty program's (start-up, the VM compiling its prelude) and less compiling the program, which is the "compile" column (the same source compiler in every build). "interpreter" is the VM with the hand-written interpreter loop, "C loop" the same VM with the loop in C, "JIT" the VM compiling methods to machine code as they are first called (compiling counts in its run). C and assembly are the draft 1 suite's versions of the same program (c_compiler and v1_isa), with the same output.

Start-up: 4,914,052 cycles on D32-separate, 1,638.0 ms at 3 MHz.
